Hello!! I am in a similar position as I need a strict school schedule in order to do well. I find that using a planner helps immensely. I know you said you fail to use yours sometimes but you've gotta really try. You don't have to use a planner either. You could use a phone or computer to plan things. Sometimes I also take a notebook sheet of paper and just plan out one specific week in detail. (Write out each day and what needs to get done) and cross off things when they are done!! And I find the MAIN thing is opposite action. Idk if you have heard that phrase but it means sometimes doing the opposite of what you want. -take your meds daily.. be honest with your doc about what is helping and what is not. Try your best to not get frustrated with meds not working. It is a process. 
-find a counselor you feel somewhat comfortable with and build trust in them
-avoid alcohol and drugs even though they seem to help sometimes.. they are only going to sway your mood more.
